objective: Enable one Agent Team to create, browse, inspect, and independently approve multiple missions in the Web UI, with each mission owning its own plan revision and lifecycle.
non_goals: Do not execute or activate a mission during planning.
Do not redesign teammate spawning, model routing, or non-Web Agent Team surfaces.
Do not add deployment, persistence migration, or external service behavior beyond the existing Team session journal and projection model.

requirements.acceptance: The Team core exposes durable mission records with stable id, title, objective, status (draft, approved, active, completed), revision, and per-mission approval; each mission owns an independent plan/task set and approval does not approve another mission.
Authorized core operations can create a mission, list missions, read one mission detail, and approve the exact current revision with stale-revision and unauthorized-operation rejection evidence.
The Web UI offers Add Mission and renders a refreshable mission list with each mission's title, status, revision, and approval state.
Selecting a mission opens its detail and an approval control approves only the displayed mission revision, showing success and conflict/error states without changing other missions.
Focused core and Web tests cover independent mission creation/list/detail/approval behavior, stale conflicts, and the requested UI flows; integration evidence binds the results to accepted bytes.

tasks.title: Confirm the focused test and build entrypoints
tasks.deliverable: wbs-runs/multi-mission-web-ui/toolchain.md records the available focused test command, its exact output, and any constraint that affects implementation verification.

criteria: toolchain.md records the actual command result and does not invent unavailable verification commands.

stop_conditions: Stop if the focused test runner is unavailable and no repository-supported equivalent can be identified without widening scope.

tasks.title: Implement durable multi-mission core state and operations
tasks.deliverable: Core Team service, types, projection, journal events, and focused tests support independent mission records, mission-owned plan revisions/tasks, create/list/detail, and exact-revision approval with durable replay and conflict handling.

criteria: Core tests demonstrate two missions can coexist with isolated revisions and approvals.
Projection replay and stale/unauthorized approval tests pass on the accepted bytes.

stop_conditions: Stop if mission isolation requires an unapproved migration to unrelated Session or provider storage.
Stop if core changes require Web-only assumptions that are not represented in the public service types.
Stop after two failed attempts without a new diagnosis.

tasks.title: Add Web mission list, detail, creation, and approval flows
tasks.deliverable: Web Team panel exposes Add Mission, a list of missions, selected mission detail, independent approval controls, refresh behavior, and localized success/conflict/error states with client tests.

criteria: The UI can create and display more than one mission without replacing another mission's detail.
The UI approves the selected mission revision and surfaces stale/conflict failures while leaving other mission approvals unchanged.

stop_conditions: Stop if the available Remote client contract cannot carry per-mission identity without changing the core API first.
Stop if the Web slot cannot support the requested detail/list interaction without unrelated shell changes.
Stop after two failed attempts without a new diagnosis.

tasks.title: Verify core and Web multi-mission integration
tasks.deliverable: wbs-runs/multi-mission-web-ui/integration.md records the exact focused test command result and binds it to the accepted core/Web source and test hashes, including remaining limitations.

criteria: The integrated focused test command succeeds on unchanged accepted inputs.
integration.md records actual output, exit status, and relevant byte hashes rather than only claiming success.

stop_conditions: Stop if the integrated command fails because accepted core or Web bytes changed after focused verification.
Stop if evidence cannot distinguish approvals for separate missions.

tasks.title: Review the multi-mission acceptance conclusion
tasks.deliverable: wbs-runs/multi-mission-web-ui/final-report.md maps each requirement to accepted evidence, records unresolved limitations, and states whether the human should accept the mission outcome.

evidence: Compare final-report.md with integration.md and the accepted core/Web bytes.
Confirm every requirement has observable evidence and that no unsupported completion claim is made.

criteria: The human accepts the exact reviewed final report for revision 1, or records a hold/rejection with the missing evidence.

stop_conditions: A human hold, rejected requirement, or missing provenance leaves final acceptance open.
